Hi team — per Marissa's request, below are recommended model options and configuration notes for the trial. I'll be the SE lead and can run a short benchmarking sweep once we have the sample set.

Primary goal: balance relevance vs cost/latency for English & Spanish; provide a practical fallback for Hindi.

Proposed models (order = preference for trial):
1) Llama 2 13B Chat (quantized q4o) — primary. Rationale: strong chat instruction tuning, good English/Spanish performance, predictable latency when quantized. Expect ~280-380ms token latency at 8 rps on a 80-token average response with q4o on A100-like hardware.
2) Mistral 7B Instruct (q4f16) — cheaper, lower latency; useful if we need cost-optimized run for high throughput. Slightly lower accuracy on subtle context.
3) BLOOMZ-3B (multilingual) — recommended as the Hindi/other-language fallback for the labeled Hindi samples; BLOOMZ tends to handle many languages better than most English-centric models at smaller scale.

Fallback policy:
- Primary: Llama 2 13B Chat.
- If latency spikes or cost threshold breached, automatic fallback to Mistral 7B for non-critical routes.
- For Hindi-labeled evaluation, run parallel comparison: primary model vs BLOOMZ to measure delta.

Quantization & perf notes:
- We'll test q4o and q4f16 configurations; q4f16 tends to be faster but sometimes loses a bit of generation quality on rare tokens.
- Use prefix KV caching for repeated context in support transcripts.

Evaluation metrics I suggest we capture (we'll produce a short eval dashboard):
- Precision/Recall/F1 on labeled responses (per-lang).
- BLEU/ROUGE for structured reply similarity if applicable.
- Average token latency and 95th percentile latency at your observed RPS.
- Cost per 1k tokens for each config.

Next actions (technical):
1) Once we receive the 2k eval set, I'll run automated evals against the three models (Jun 3–Jun 5).
2) We'll provide quantized config artifacts + recommended canary settings for production.
3) If Clearsight needs encrypted private deployment, we can tee up a Private eval, but that's a separate conversation.

Happy to jump on a 30-min tech kickoff during the week of Jun 8.

Thanks,
